## Featured Projects
- [Leath Notes](https://leath-note.my.id): Skeuomorphic online notepad with folders, autosave, drag-and-drop organization, guest mode, authentication, and optional multi-provider AI assistance, built with Next.js 15, tRPC, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
- [RoadSense](https://github.com/LIan2nd/RoadSense): Smart GIS road damage mapping & navigation using Next.js 15, Leaflet, Flask (Shapely), and OSRM routing.
- [DigiArc](https://digiarc.vercel.app): Decentralized Web3 file storage on IPFS with Solidity smart contracts and Next.js / Wagmi.
- [ESAO](https://esao.nurulfikri.ac.id): Automated AI essay grading platform for university lecturers using Next.js, Flask, and LangChain.
- [Event Management System](https://github.com/LIan2nd/sistem-pendaftaran-event): Event registration platform built with Laravel MVC, authentication, and role management.
- [HRD RESTful API](https://github.com/LIan2nd/uas-pemrograman-backend): Modular MVC/OOP backend in Express.js and MySQL.
- [Tetrisn't](https://github.com/LIan2nd/Tetrisn-t): Reverse puzzle game built in Unity (C#) where lines only clear when left with one gap.
